categories.title: Catapult Seal
categories.info:
Need a boost? Use the powerful bouncing tails of seal Whimborn to launch Nikki up, up, and away!

Speak to the NPC nearby to feed the seal. When its tail glows, the seal is ready to launch Nikki.

locations.title: Bubblebloom Field
locations.description:
**Tier:** 2F - 

_The place where the Soakville villagers cultivate Bubblebloom. Bubbles drift gently, carrying away worries. The Pieceys believe that these delicate, transparent bubbles life away dirt and troubles, leaving only freshness and serenity._

locations.description:
**Tier:** 2F - Cleansing Lotion Brewing Area

locations.description: _Discovering Clear Salt was a small step for Macy, but a giant leap for Steamville! From fine granules to hefty crystal chunks, Steamville offers just the right bath method to bring out the full potential of each kind._

locations.title: Nectar Nook
locations.description: _A garden blooming with flowers of every kind. Drawn in by the sweet blossoms are not only Pieceys looking to adorn themselves, but also the finest floral connoisseurs of all--the Foodie Bee._

locations.title: Misty Peak
locations.description: _Thread not upon that Misty Peak, nor disturb the slumber of Silvergale. Yet, none have ever seen the Silvergale unfurl its wings._

locations.title: Patchwork Clinic

locations.title: Saltwrap Bathhouse
locations.description: _Wrapped in large grains of salt, rolling under the scorching heat... Don't be mistaken, these are essential steps in the "Saltly Hard Fabric Challenge." The Piecey that endures the longest is the true tough fabric!_

locations.title: Old Ruins
locations.description: _The remnants of humanity, their origin unknown. "All the Pieceys know 'humans,' but have never seen one. That's why the Old Ruins is worth exploring," -- as noted on the Piecey Adventure Ranking._
